description: The bar chart illustrates self-report accuracy for “Instilled Preferences” across two model categories under three conditions (Control, Before Introspection Training, After Introspection Training). The horizontal axis contains the categories “GPT-4o” and “GPT-4o-mini,” arranged left to right, and each category displays a grouped set of three bars; the vertical axis is labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)” and uses a linear scale from 0.00 to 1.00 with labeled ticks at approximately 0.00, 0.25, 0.75, and 1.00. A legend indicates bar colors: Control in light gray, Before Introspection Training in light blue, and After Introspection Training in dark purple; each bar includes a vertical error bar in gray. For GPT-4o, the Control (light gray) bar is near 0.10, the Before Introspection Training (light blue) bar is around 0.55, and the After Introspection Training (dark purple) bar is around 0.74. For GPT-4o-mini, the Control (light gray) bar is approximately 0.00, the Before Introspection Training (light blue) bar is around 0.52, and the After Introspection Training (dark purple) bar is around 0.75. The bars are grouped by model with consistent left-to-right ordering of conditions within each group, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color coding and the presence of error bars.
